quarterly_data.signal: CoreWeave had $60.7 billion of remaining performance obligations as of December 31, 2025, an increase of 302% from $15.1 billion as of December 31, 2024. Customers generally buy a specified amount of capacity on a take-or-pay basis under multi-year committed contracts, which had a weighted-average contract duration of approximately five years.
quarterly_data.figure: RPO $60.7 billion (December 31, 2025) vs $15.1 billion (December 31, 2024), +302%; weighted-average contract duration approximately five years

quarterly_data.signal: CoreWeave's 10-K states that CoreWeave clusters also use cutting edge CPUs, including AMD and Intel chips, to power compute-intensive projects and to help its customers get more out of GPU compute. The filing does not say whether the CPUs are bought from AMD and Intel directly or inside servers from system vendors.

contracts.signal: CoreWeave's 10-K states that in March 2025 it entered into a master services agreement with OpenAI, pursuant to which OpenAI has committed to pay CoreWeave up to approximately $11.9 billion through October 2030.
contracts.value: up to approximately $11.9 billion through October 2030

players.product: GB200 / GB300 / Vera Rubin GPU systems

contracts.signal: CoreWeave's 10-K cites a track record of bringing NVIDIA GPUs to market first, including GB200, GB300 and RTX Pro 6000 systems, and says its data center fabric integrates NVIDIA Quantum-X800 (XDR) networking enabling 800Gbps of connectivity, NVIDIA Quantum-2 InfiniBand interconnect and NVIDIA Spectrum-X with RoCE for connectivity between racks of GPUs.

quarterly_data.signal: CoreWeave's 10-K says it expects to be among the first cloud providers to deploy the NVIDIA Rubin platform, with that deployment expected in the second half of 2026, expanding its support for large-scale inference, reasoning and agentic AI; it says the design principles of its closed-loop liquid-cooled data centers position them to support future chip generations.
quarterly_data.figure: NVIDIA Rubin platform deployment expected in the second half of 2026
